text: 宁德时代上周完成新一期中票发行，使其年内债券融资突破400亿元人民币，超过历年发债规模总和。数据显示，宁德时代上半年净新增有息负债约294亿元，其中近九成增量来自债券融资。有息负债总额虽继续扩张，但上半年利息费用同比下降逾10%，反映出公司通过增加债券融资、优化债务结构等方式压降融资成本。
text_en: CATL completed a new tranche of medium-term notes last week, pushing its bond financing this year past 40 billion yuan, exceeding the total bond issuance in all prior years. Data shows CATL's net new interest-bearing debt in the first half was about 29.4 billion yuan, with nearly 90% of the increase coming from bond financing. While total interest-bearing debt continues to expand, interest expenses in the first half fell over 10% year-on-year, reflecting efforts to lower financing costs through increased bond financing and optimized debt structure.
